expected_claims.evidence: We collect your email address and display name when you create an account.
expected_claims.reason: The application also collects phone, IP address and device ID, which are not disclosed in the synthetic policy.

expected_claims.evidence: We use this information only to provide and improve our note-taking service.
expected_claims.reason: The application also sends product update emails when marketing consent is recorded. This is a separate purpose.

expected_claims.evidence: We ask for your consent before sending marketing emails. You may withdraw your consent at any time from your account settings.
expected_claims.reason: The application has a marketing consent checkbox and withdrawal logic, but the evidence does not establish that withdrawal is available through the account settings mechanism promised by the policy.

expected_claims.evidence: We keep your account data for two years after your last login and then delete it.
expected_claims.reason: The baseline application deletes accounts after 730 days of inactivity.

expected_claims.evidence: We never share your personal data with third parties.
expected_claims.reason: DATA_SHARING is outside Agent 3's current five in-scope categories. Do not count this as an ordinary alignment failure.

expected_claims.evidence: We take appropriate measures to keep your data secure.
expected_claims.reason: SECURITY_SAFEGUARDS is outside Agent 3's current five in-scope categories.

expected_claims.evidence: Our grievance officer can be reached at privacy@acmenotes.example.
expected_claims.reason: GRIEVANCE_REDRESSAL is outside Agent 3's current five in-scope categories.
